accepted_properties: Independent python -B verify passed once with the separately supplied exact lock SHA256. The selected tool files matched their frozen Git commit and stayed unchanged; lock bytes stayed unchanged.

All 116 explicit relationships were reviewed: actual retained HTTP binary digest is shared by build, execution-before/after and product record; the entire source file map, source freeze, build command/profile/features, capture helpers and original logs are linked.
Independently derived complete Cargo.toml/Cargo.lock/crates path set and all 772 Git blob SHA256 values equal the source manifest and locked source file map at 93356fc8.

The local/auto/semantic reports embed the same complete BuildReceipt and bind suite configuration, scoring, source/query declarations, observed source head and policy. Only the canonical 588e809 HTTP product is selected; default smoke is not reclassified.
All 120 selected original evidence files, including all 102 report files, have lengths and hashes equal to the already independently verified original checkpoint archive index at 4b78f683.

The selected report and source trees include all file and directory membership without exclusions. The external pin protects the exact specification and records; preparing a new lock uses exclusive output outside selected inputs.
Environment values are a projection of existing allowlisted records, cross-checked across cells and build profile; null hardware, provider cost and quality unknowns are retained.

author_real_copy_negative_control.description: The author copied existing selected inputs with copy2/copytree into a private temporary root, verified it unchanged, then added one unlisted report file and observed the expected rejection. The original path stayed absent.

limits: This pins selected bytes and supplied relationships. It does not establish independent receipt authenticity, past execution, hermetic source/build completeness or continuous filesystem atomicity.
Native BLAKE3 corpus/query declarations are retained and related across the suite and reports. The SHA256 locker does not rerun the native loader/scorer or replace their execution evidence.
The benchmark remains a synthetic fake-provider loopback engineering run. No live model revision, semantic benefit, holdout quality, real hardware/cost or resource certification is added.
The copied executable and source snapshot are external selected inputs required for future verification. This does not convert their hashes into a reproducible-binary or remote-attestation guarantee.
P7-020 and the complete P7-019/P8-001 acceptance remain open. release_candidate and execution_attestation are false.
This review did not rerun the fifteen stdlib controls, execute Rust or a product, modify original reports, or create a new benchmark run.
scope: Concrete input lock for the prior canonical P7-019 HTTP engineering run. Source utility review, storage review, historical benchmark execution and this read-only byte verification remain distinct.
